name: luvora
description: Luvora — a private, consent-first interactive fantasy platform for adults (18+). Server-authoritative multiplayer, non-graphic romance scenarios.

scripts.build: npm run -w @luvora/shared build && npm run -w @luvora/backend build && npm run -w @luvora/web build
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w @luvora/shared typecheck && npm run -w @luvora/backend typecheck && npm run -w @luvora/web typecheck
scripts.test: npm run -w @luvora/backend test && npm run -w @luvora/web test
